We recently had solar and a battery system installed by this incredible company, and we couldn’t be happier with the entire experience! From start to finish, the service was nothing short of exceptional. We knew we were in the best hands possible from the first phone call. We couldn’t recommend this company more highly. If you’re looking for solar done right — with excellent workmanship, honest advice, and first-class customer service — look no further!A special mention has to go to Paul, who is an absolute gem! His customer service skills are outstanding — he took the time to explain everything about solar in a way that was easy to understand, answering all our questions with patience and genuine care. I sent out quite a few quote requests, and PBR stood out from the others straight away.  Paul took lots of time during our initial call to understand our needs and to study the property.  His design met our brief.  We spoke a few times and he answered our questions and adjusted the plan as we went.This contrasts with the other companies that sent me a design by email without trying to understand my needs or model alternatives.Dillon came to visit the house, to plan the install.The installation itself was excellent. The layout of the house is tricky, and there were some unexpected issues late in the day with our 3-phase wiring, but Ethan and his team worked until it was rectified.I felt they were invested in a good outcome, and suspect that has a lot to do with the owners being hands-on. For example they took care to hide the wiring coming from the roof, and to make the battery and other components look presentable.The other thing I like is their attention to safety. I felt that Dillon and Ethan looked after their team. As a customer I don't want costs to be cut by them taking undue risks.I am reassured that they are available for any issues that might arise - leaving their direct contact details at the end of the job gives me confidence that they are happy with the outcome.
